patch_transformers_for_legacy_imports: patch transformers version 4.x to support legacy import paths from older code
safecopy_modules_before_patch: safely save references to original module functions before patching them with new implementations
restore_saved_modules_after_patch: restore previously saved original module functions back to their caller modules after patching
review_patch_transformers_function: review the patch_transformers function that patches transformers 4.x for backward compatibility with older code
summarize_safecopy_and_restore: summarize the safecopy_modules and restore_saved_modules functions used for safe function patching and restoration
